note: Hand-entered development fixture for the proposed seed field (parameter-efficient fine-tuning). Metadata is from arXiv listings and should be replaced by the OpenAlex import. Summaries are ours, not the papers' abstracts. Parent weights are ILLUSTRATIVE: they were not assessed by AI or approved by a panel (OIP-14), and exist only to exercise the waterfall.

works.title: Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for NLP
works.summary: Adds small trainable adapter modules between frozen transformer layers.

works.title: Intrinsic Dimensionality Explains the Effectiveness of Language Model Fine-Tuning
works.summary: Shows that fine-tuning large language models works in a very low-dimensional subspace.

works.title: Prefix-Tuning: Optimizing Continuous Prompts for Generation
works.summary: Trains a small continuous prefix of activations while the language model stays frozen.

works.title: The Power of Scale for Parameter-Efficient Prompt Tuning
works.summary: Learns soft prompt embeddings only, and shows the gap to full fine-tuning closes with model scale.

works.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
works.summary: Freezes pretrained weights and trains low-rank update matrices injected into each layer.

works.title: AdaLoRA: Adaptive Budget Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
works.summary: Allocates the low-rank budget across weight matrices by importance during training.

works.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
works.summary: Trains LoRA adapters on top of a frozen 4-bit quantized model.

works.title: DoRA: Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation
works.summary: Splits weights into magnitude and direction and applies LoRA to the direction.
